about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

moving SPACES into f77_WS_M03B_FLDT before calling CBSTM03B; on successful read CBSTM03B overwrites the field with the record, and on error the program abends without reading the field

in 8200-XREFFILE-OPEN (paragraph 16), GO TO 0000-START jumps to the dispatcher which alters alt14 to 17 and jumps to paragraph 17 (8300-CUSTFILE-OPEN); negating the jump falls through to return 17, which reaches the identical paragraph 17 directly
binary precision 4 -> 5 when adding 1 to TR-CNT; transaction count per card never exceeds 9999, so 4-digit and 5-digit binary representations return the identical numeric value
moving ZEROS to f74_WS_M03B_RC before CALL 'CBSTM03B' (ACCTFILE CLOSE); LK-M03B-RC is an output parameter written by CBSTM03B and never read by it, so pre-clearing it is unobservable
